Her hands fall to her sides bent, then extend outward with open palms in a waving gesture.
She lifts her hands to chest height, palms forward, easing slightly outward in a rhythmic movement.
The mirror reflection tracks her front-facing movements while ceiling lights and wall vent stay fixed.
caption:
A woman with long dark hair, dressed in a red Santa outfit trimmed with white fur, a matching hat and cream thigh-high boots, stands with her back to the camera in a bright white studio. A floor-to-ceiling mirror on the right returns her front-facing reflection, tracking her movements. At the beginning, both her arms are already raised. Open palms are held at shoulder and head height, fingers splayed, with only small adjustments.

Then she lowers both arms, drawing her hands inward toward each other in a gathering motion. She lets them fall to her sides with bent hands near her hips while her weight shifts. Next she extends her arms outward, open palms presented in a waving gesture. Afterward she lifts her hands again to chest height, palms facing forward, easing them slightly outward in a rhythmic movement. The ceiling track lights and the wall vent at top left keep constant positions throughout.
